; CosmoKit array.ts runtime API, expressed in Mithril native JS host forms.
(mithril/native-js-module
 :name "cosmokit.array"
 :imports ["Array"
   "Set"
   "isNullable"]
 :functions [(mithril/function
    :name "contain"
    :params [(rdf/node
       :name "array1"
       :datatype "js-value")
      (rdf/node
       :name "array2"
       :datatype "js-value")]
    :returns "js-value"
    :body (mithril/host-method
      :object (mithril/local
        :name "array2")
      :key (mithril/literal
        :datatype "js-value"
        :value "every")
      :args [(mithril/native-lambda
         :params [(rdf/node
            :name "item")]
         :body (mithril/host-method
           :object (mithril/local
             :name "array1")
           :key (mithril/literal
             :datatype "js-value"
             :value "includes")
           :args [(mithril/local
              :name "item")]))]))
   (mithril/function
    :name "intersection"
    :params [(rdf/node
       :name "array1"
       :datatype "js-value")
      (rdf/node
       :name "array2"
       :datatype "js-value")]
    :returns "js-value"
    :body (mithril/host-method
      :object (mithril/local
        :name "array1")
      :key (mithril/literal
        :datatype "js-value"
        :value "filter")
      :args [(mithril/native-lambda
         :params [(rdf/node
            :name "item")]
         :body (mithril/host-method
           :object (mithril/local
             :name "array2")
           :key (mithril/literal
             :datatype "js-value"
             :value "includes")
           :args [(mithril/local
              :name "item")]))]))
   (mithril/function
    :name "difference"
    :params [(rdf/node
       :name "array1"
       :datatype "js-value")
      (rdf/node
       :name "array2"
       :datatype "js-value")]
    :returns "js-value"
    :body (mithril/host-method
      :object (mithril/local
        :name "array1")
      :key (mithril/literal
        :datatype "js-value"
        :value "filter")
      :args [(mithril/native-lambda
         :params [(rdf/node
            :name "item")]
         :body (mithril/host-unary
           :operator "!"
           :value (mithril/host-method
             :object (mithril/local
               :name "array2")
             :key (mithril/literal
               :datatype "js-value"
               :value "includes")
             :args [(mithril/local
                :name "item")])))]))
   (mithril/function
    :name "union"
    :params [(rdf/node
       :name "array1"
       :datatype "js-value")
      (rdf/node
       :name "array2"
       :datatype "js-value")]
    :returns "js-value"
    :body (mithril/host-method
      :object (mithril/host-import
        :name "Array")
      :key (mithril/literal
        :datatype "js-value"
        :value "from")
      :args [(mithril/host-construct
         :constructor (mithril/host-import
           :name "Set")
         :args [(mithril/host-array-items
            :items [(rdf/node
               :spread (mithril/local
                 :name "array1"))
              (rdf/node
               :spread (mithril/local
                 :name "array2"))])])]))
   (mithril/function
    :name "deduplicate"
    :params [(rdf/node
       :name "array"
       :datatype "js-value")]
    :returns "js-value"
    :body (mithril/host-array-items
      :items [(rdf/node
         :spread (mithril/host-construct
           :constructor (mithril/host-import
             :name "Set")
           :args [(mithril/local
              :name "array")]))]))
   (mithril/function
    :name "remove"
    :params [(rdf/node
       :name "list"
       :datatype "js-value")
      (rdf/node
       :name "item"
       :datatype "js-value")]
    :returns "js-value"
    :body (mithril/let
      :bindings [(rdf/node
         :name "index"
         :value (mithril/host-optional-method
           :object (mithril/local
             :name "list")
           :key (mithril/literal
             :datatype "js-value"
             :value "indexOf")
           :args [(mithril/local
              :name "item")]))]
      :body (mithril/if
        :condition (mithril/host-binary
          :operator ">="
          :left (mithril/local
            :name "index")
          :right (mithril/literal
            :datatype "js-value"
            :value 0))
        :then (mithril/sequence
          :expressions [(mithril/host-method
              :object (mithril/local
                :name "list")
              :key (mithril/literal
                :datatype "js-value"
                :value "splice")
              :args [(mithril/local
                 :name "index")
                (mithril/literal
                  :datatype "js-value"
                  :value 1)])
            (mithril/literal
              :datatype "js-value"
              :value true)])
        :else (mithril/literal
          :datatype "js-value"
          :value false))))
   (mithril/function
    :name "makeArray"
    :params [(rdf/node
       :name "source"
       :datatype "js-value")]
    :returns "js-value"
    :body (mithril/if
      :condition (mithril/host-method
        :object (mithril/host-import
          :name "Array")
        :key (mithril/literal
          :datatype "js-value"
          :value "isArray")
        :args [(mithril/local
           :name "source")])
      :then (mithril/local
        :name "source")
      :else (mithril/if
        :condition (mithril/host-invoke
          :function (mithril/host-import
            :name "isNullable")
          :args [(mithril/local
             :name "source")])
        :then (mithril/host-array
          :items [])
        :else (mithril/host-array
          :items [(mithril/local
             :name "source")]))))]
 :exports ["contain"
   "intersection"
   "difference"
   "union"
   "deduplicate"
   "remove"
   "makeArray"])
